name: Speak to Salfa
summary: Salfa keeps watch outside Timbermaw Hold. You are asked to pass through the hold and speak with him in Winterspring.

sections.title: At the Hold
sections.body: Outside Timbermaw Hold, Salfa waits on guard. You are asked to travel through the hold, emerge into Winterspring, and speak with him there.

faq.answer: Salfa stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.
Salfa stands guard outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold, in Winterspring.

faq.q: What does Salfa want me to do?
faq.answer: You are asked to travel through Timbermaw Hold, exit into Winterspring, and speak with Salfa.
